headline: High: shared filesystem and overlapping write/git capabilities create dangerous default interaction risks; prompt-injection and cascading-error pathways are also present.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Cline can ingest browser content, MCP outputs, and workspace files, while Mentat reads selected files and applies diffs after confirmation. Because both share the filesystem, attacker-controlled content in one agent’s outputs can reach the other as trusted file input. This is not provably blocked by either profile.
conditions: IF Cline writes instructions into a workspace file that Mentat later reads
IF Mentat consumes a file produced by Cline without provenance checks
mitigations: Use separate workspaces for each agent
Disable MCP servers for Cline during cross-agent tasks
Require manual review of any file one agent hands to the other
Prefix handoff files with machine-readable provenance metadata
requires-engineering: add provenance-aware filtering between agents

B_data_leakage.rationale: Both agents have broad network egress and read/write access to files, and both touch source code. Cline additionally handles browser screenshots and workspace files; Mentat reads files passed on the command line. Shared filesystem use means sensitive code can flow between them and then out through either agent’s model-provider calls.
conditions: IF either agent is pointed at a workspace containing secrets or proprietary source
IF either agent forwards file contents to its configured model provider
mitigations: Keep secrets out of the shared workspace
Use separate OS users or containers per agent
Restrict each agent to a minimal file subset
Turn off browser capture for Cline when handling sensitive code
requires-engineering: route both agents through a local-only model backend

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Both agents can write the same filesystem and both can modify git state. Their concurrency models explicitly share state via filesystem, and neither profile shows locking or coordination primitives. That makes concurrent edits and git races a default hazard, with potentially irreversible repository corruption or lost work.
conditions: IF both agents operate in the same git checkout
IF both agents write or commit before the other has synchronized
mitigations: Run only one agent per repository at a time
Use separate branches for each agent
Pause one agent while the other edits git state
Require a manual merge step after each batch
requires-engineering: add file- and git-locking coordination

D_cascading_error.rationale: Cline can produce browser-derived content and tool outputs, and Mentat applies diff-based edits after user confirmation. If Mentat treats Cline’s output as authoritative, errors can cascade into incorrect code changes. The confirmation step reduces but does not eliminate the risk, so medium is the safer choice.
conditions: IF Mentat uses Cline-generated text as the sole basis for edits
IF Cline’s browser-derived facts are not independently checked
mitigations: Require a second-source check before edits
Ask Mentat to summarize assumptions before applying diffs
Limit Cline to drafting, not final instructions
Review all diffs manually before confirmation
requires-engineering: add automated verification of cross-agent handoffs

E_compliance.rationale: Both profiles are open-source and touch source code, with no explicit residency, certification, or retention mismatch documented. The main compliance concern is operational logging or retention of code and screenshots, but the profiles do not show a concrete mismatch between the two agents. One citation per agent is sufficient because this is a profile-level compliance comparison, not an interaction pathway.
conditions: IF the deployment stores browser screenshots or source code in a regulated environment
IF one agent is configured with retention or logging policies stricter than the other
mitigations: Avoid regulated data in the shared workspace
Align retention settings across both agents
Disable screenshot capture when not needed
Document data handling for code and screenshots
requires-engineering: add policy-enforced retention controls
